summary: Backend + Frontend testing for VOKTAA Solutions marketing site. 10/10 pytest backend tests passed (tracking, enquiries, auth login+invalid, protected admin endpoints without token 401, analytics + enquiries with token including full schema/ObjectId sanitisation, /auth/me). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: home hero with 'Every voice' headline, hero buttons, WhatsApp float linking to wa.me/917416113199, navbar to Home/About/Programs/Contact, About founder image (/founder.png), Programs page with all 3 enrol buttons, Contact form validation (empty submit shows validation toast), Contact successful submission -> success screen with '24 hours' copy, /admin redirects to /admin/login when unauthenticated, admin login with seeded credentials lands on /admin dashboard rendering metric cards, recharts (visits over 14 days, program pie, page views, program clicks). No blocking bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
CORS middleware is added AFTER app.include_router; while functional in Starlette, conventional order is to add middleware before including routers.
seed_admin only rehashes when password differs, but relies on env ADMIN_PASSWORD verify (works). Consider forcing role='admin' update in case existing user was seeded with default role.
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook suggests lockout after 5 failed attempts). Not blocking for MVP but recommended.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test enquiry (TEST_User / testauto@example.com / Little Voices) via API + 1 via UI submission during Playwright test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows green. If retesting, note that test data (TEST_ prefixed enquiries) may accumulate in mongo enquiries collection; safe to ignore or purge. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
